_doc: Bách Vũ Các lineage (rules-proposals R5). Re-ordered Fire, Wood -> Wood, Fire to its seat (place 330: Wood 33 %, Fire 20 %). Outer gate: hundred-call-breath (Wood + Fire, proposal). Inner gate and above: roosting-branch-canon (Wood, proposal; a beast tamer's method of bonded birds). Secret art: moulted-feather-fan (inner, Fire, proposal). Proposals are unpriced.

lineage.tree_route_note: The roosting branch: Beast Pen and Beast Claw for bonded birds, then the Spirit Lantern of the Beast-Soul Totem that keeps them alive.

techniques.name: Hundred-Call Breath (Bách Minh Tức)
techniques.concept: A bird catcher's breathing, done in the canopy at dawn and dusk when the birds call. The disciple learns one call per layer and breathes with it: Wood qi drawn in as the forest breathes, a little Fire let out on the call. A catcher at the sixth layer can bring a wild bird to the hand without a net. It is a quiet method and makes quiet people.

arts.concept: Calls a wild bird to harry a foe for a few seconds: light hits and a small chance to interrupt their art.

arts.new: Still on the Branch (Chi Thượng Tĩnh)
arts.concept: A still stance: while you are Composed you gain evasion, and your next art's timer is 0.5 s shorter.

techniques.lore: Tuyên Bách Minh's calls, written down by Tạ Thanh Thước in 1112 so that the catchers' children would not have to learn them only by ear.

techniques.name: Roosting Branch Canon (Thê Chi Kinh)
techniques.concept: The pavilion's method: the cultivator makes herself a tree that spirit birds will roost in. Each layer grows one more branch of the meridians that a bonded bird can perch on, and a cultivator at the ninth layer carries three birds whose qi flows into hers and hers into theirs. In a fight the birds strike, scout and shield; when a bird is hurt, the holder feels it, and when the holder heals, so do they.

arts.concept: Sends her bonded birds at a foe: several quick hits that each lay a Wood stack; more birds at higher layers.
One bird shields you and takes your next hit (a decoy); the bird returns to the branch to heal.

techniques.lore: Made by Tạ Thanh Loan and her sister between 1110 and 1140 from the palace's bird-keeping notes, which Vu Ngô Đồng lent them, and from what they knew of birds. It is the newest main method of any of the palace's vassals.

techniques.name: Moulted Feather Fan (Thoái Vũ Phiến Quyết)
techniques.concept: A fan art made with feathers gathered only from moults. The fan's feathers keep the qi of the birds that shed them; a stroke throws them burning, and each kind of feather does a different small thing. A keeper's fan shows how many kinds she has gathered, and the art grows stronger with every new kind added.

arts.concept: A fan stroke that throws burning feathers in a cone: Fire hits that each lay one Fire stack.
Passive: for each different feather kind in the holder's fan (counted by item grade), her Fire stacks last a little longer.

techniques.lore: The pavilion makes the inner gate's practice fans for Phượng Minh, and this is the fan art the palace does not teach: the palace's Morning Sun Feather Fan burns feathers it is given, and this one keeps the birds' own qi.

techniques.name: Woven Cage Breath (Biên Lung Tức)
techniques.concept: The pavilion's servant craft method for the one cage-maker Bách Vũ Các permits. Metal and Earth qi are drawn steadily through the hands to temper split bamboo and wire; it opens no gate and teaches no bird calls.

arts.concept: A cage-maker's quick wire-and-needle thrust: a Physical Metal hit that lays 1 Metal stack for 6 s.

techniques.lore: Passed to Hoàn Trúc Lung when he came up from the raft villages to weave training cages and travelling baskets for the lofts.
